answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of DavIR across model families (LLaMA, Gemma) and across data domains (Alpaca, LIMA, GSM8K) and across benchmarks (Self-Instruct, Vicuna, Koala, OpenAssistant, Helpful Base, GSM8K).
answer_1.outputs: Generated instruction-following or free-form responses to prompts

answer_3.quote: For open-domain freeform QA style evaluation of LLaMA models ... we used a combination of LLM (GPT-4) and human as referee.

answer_4.quote: One human annotator (unpaid, college educated, age 20-25, proficient in English) was provided side‑by‑side comparison of two responses generated by two models for each question and asked to determine whether the response on the "left" is better/same/worse (win/tie/lose) than the response on the "right".
answer_4.guideline: Annotator compares two model outputs side‑by‑side and judges which is better, same, or worse.
